parameters.name: ConsumerGroupName
parameters.description: The name of the consumer group. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. Specify a business-meaningful name for easy identification.

parameters.name: ConsumerGroupPassword
parameters.description:
The password of the consumer group account.

- The password must contain characters from at least two of the following categories: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
- The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.

parameters.name: ConsumerGroupUserName
parameters.description:
The username of the consumer group account.

The username can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_). The username can be up to 16 characters in length.

parameters.name: DtsInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the instance ID.
> You must specify one of the **DtsInstanceId** and **DtsJobId** parameters.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description:
The ID of the change tracking task. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the task ID.
> You must specify one of the **DtsInstanceId** and **DtsJobId** parameters.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the DTS change tracking instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).
